summary.text: Theresa Livingston is the Democratic candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 27, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent Martha Lawley (R) is also on the ballot.
She served in the U.S. Air Force from 1972 to 1981 and has worked as a special education paraprofessional.

paragraphs.text: Theresa Livingston has served as a member of Team Rubicon since 2015, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she was a nine-year Air Force veteran, worked for the Department of the Interior's Bureau of Land Management for 15 years, and worked in schools as a special education paraprofessional for 11 years.
Livingston was the Democratic nominee for Governor of Wyoming in 2022, receiving 15.8 percent of the vote against incumbent Mark Gordon (R) in the general election.
She was also the Democratic nominee for Wyoming State Senate District 20 in 2020, when Ed Cooper (R) won the general election with 85.0 percent to her 14.7 percent.
